definitions.explanation: Paper manufactured from recycled waste paper rather than virgin pulp.

examples.japanese: この{名刺|めいし}は{再生紙|さいせいし}で{作|つく}られている。
examples.english: This business card is made from recycled paper.

examples.japanese: {再生紙|さいせいし}を{使|つか}うことで{環境|かんきょう}に{貢献|こうけん}できる。
examples.english: Using recycled paper can contribute to the environment.

examples.japanese: {社内|しゃない}の{印刷|いんさつ}はすべて{再生紙|さいせいし}に{切|き}り{替|か}えた。
examples.english: We switched all in-house printing to recycled paper.

notes:
Paper made from waste paper or recycled materials. A compound of {再生|さいせい} (recycling; regeneration) and {紙|し} (paper). Common in discussions about environmental sustainability and corporate responsibility in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再生紙|さいせいし}を{使|つか}う: to use recycled paper
- {再生紙|さいせいし}{配合|はいごう}{率|りつ}: recycled paper content ratio
- {再生紙|さいせいし}100%: 100% recycled paper
- {再生紙|さいせいし}トイレットペーパー: recycled toilet paper

RELATED WORDS:
- {古紙|こし}: waste paper; used paper (the raw material)
- リサイクル: recycling
- {環境|かんきょう}にやさしい: environmentally friendly
